title: Crisis engine consumes the ODN-14 event buffer as sim input, making the app's never-drain behavior a correctness contract
detail: Sim logic now reads the cross-layer event buffer whose documented contract is app-side draining after each step. Any future app drain/filter (ODN-14's purpose) silently breaks crisis trigger/resolve attribution; the tripwire comment is a human-only guard.
recommended_fix: Have flow_step record per-tick drop sites in a dedicated per-tick field on Flow_State (cleared each tick); crisis_evaluate reads that instead of scanning state.events.

title: Step tick-monotonicity latch rejects only backward ticks, not repeats, despite claiming strictly monotonic
detail: The documented invariant is strict monotonicity; the check enforces only non-decreasing. A tick == state.tick call would re-execute the whole tick (double spawn, double flow, duplicate events for one tick). No current caller does it, but the guard is weaker than its claim.
recommended_fix: Reject equality too: `if tick <= state.tick` — or amend the comment to document non-decreasing semantics.

title: Stale golden-stability comment in state_writer now contradicts the 4.2 drop-payload growth
detail: The 4.2 line grows every Packet_Dropped payload by 4 bytes, so drop-bearing T1 manifests shift (deliberate, cause-documented re-bless). The adjacent comment still asserts "existing T1 manifests must not shift" with no 4.2 exception — misleading for future maintainers.
recommended_fix: Amend the comment: note the 4.2 drop-payload exception and the cause-documented re-bless, keeping the no-drop-stream byte-identity claim.

title: E13 dedup key (archetype, set_piece) is coarser than arch §6.4's per-root-cause key; comments conflate the two
detail: The (archetype, set_piece) key permits at most one active crisis per activation regardless of kind; §6.4's per-root-cause key would allow distinct simultaneous causes. While a Saturated_Bundle crisis is active, the Pool_Exhaustion backstop for the same set-piece is suppressed until resolve. MVP-safe; comments conflate both keys.
recommended_fix: Key active/cooldown entries on (archetype, set_piece, kind) to match §6.4, or update the §6.4 comment to pin the per-activation key.
